notes: The tolerance was registered at pending in the commit named by the protocol's freeze witness, before the comparison was run. This record promotes nothing on its own.

Three-way: OLV computeVRM (3x3) against SAGA 7.8.2 Vector Ruggedness Measure AND against the closed-form Sappington VRM from the analytic gradient. The fixture is smooth and well resolved so Horn's normal and SAGA's estimator converge to the analytic normal; OLV reproduces the closed form to under 1e-9, so the closed-form leg carries correctness and the SAGA leg independence.

reference.containerPinningNote: A container digest is the pin this record wants. SAGA was invoked from the saga_cmd bundled in QGIS-LTR.app on the host; no container was pulled, so the resolved path, the version SAGA reports and the exact command line stand in for it.
reference.commandLine: saga_cmd ta_morphometry 17 -DEM=<crs.tif> -VRM=<out.tif> -MODE=1 -RADIUS=1 -DW_WEIGHTING=0, then gdal_translate -of AAIGrid -co DECIMAL_PRECISION=9

datasets.description: Smooth tilted quadratic z=a·x+c·(x²+y²), 60 by 60 cells at 1 m, slope non-zero everywhere (no aspect singularity) and gentle curvature well resolved by the grid.

parameterSets.description: VRM as one minus the 3x3 mean-resultant of unit normals (computeVRM windowCells 3), interior with a two-cell border removed, compared against SAGA VRM (RADIUS 1, MODE 1, no weighting) and against the closed-form Sappington VRM.

statusReason: All 3136 interior cells are within the registered 1e-4, against BOTH SAGA VRM (largest difference 1.71e-5) and the closed-form Sappington VRM (largest difference under 1e-9). Nothing was widened.

unsupported: The two-cell border, where Horn's edge clamp halves the slope and the 3x3 window carries it inward.
Under-resolved sharp features, where discrete slope/aspect estimators diverge and OLV and SAGA differ by up to about 1e-2.
Agreement with SAGA is not accuracy against ground truth.
